title: Grateful Dead Live at Springer's Inn Portland on 1970-01-16
source: restoration of source ID 7111; see info file for details

ai_review.summary: Soundboard restoration shines on the latter half, delivering hot renditions of Easy Wind, Dire Wolf and a stellar Uncle John's Band intro.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source that needed cleanup; the first fifteen tracks still feel a bit fast and thin, but the final ten are clear and well balanced. Musically the show is a treat – early on it’s brisk, then the band really cooks in the second half with Easy Wind, Dire Wolf, Anthem of the Sun and an unforgettable Uncle John's Band guitar intro. Overall the performance is praised as “over‑the‑top” and the remaster work is widely appreciated.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (3 of 4) give 4–5 stars and highlight strong late‑set performances; recording quality is mixed but the restored soundboard makes the latter half very listenable, yielding a combined weighted score around 4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early portion described as fast and poorer‑quality; later tracks praised as clean after cleanup work. Overall the restored soundboard is listenable with noticeable improvement in the final ten tracks.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First half feels a bit rushed and thin, but the second half builds momentum with hot renditions and extended jams, delivering a satisfying climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar intro for Uncle John's Band highlighted; quoted as “This song is related to Morning Dew” – Jerry.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum segment noted within the Cryptical > Drums > Other One jam.
